set.body: Atlas INT8 review F3: scalafim pins image4s 2c0638fb (now reachable via image4s main c9fcab2) but reframe4s (local 9a450835, origin 5f7152aa) pins image4s 26a74ad, so the default build loads two image4s copies (diamond; scalafim's copy first on JVM; differences additive). build.sbt forwards scalafim.image4s.build -> reframe4s.image4s.build only for local-path overrides. Fix: reframe4s PR pinning image4s c9fcab2, then re-pin scalafim reframe4s (after the origin reconcile) and optionally image4s -> c9fcab2; verify with export atlasJVM/Test/fullClasspath. Upstream PR needs owner OK.
set.title: Bump reframe4s image4s pin to image4s main c9fcab2 and re-pin scalafim (single image4s on classpath)
